get_min_dependency_version: get the minimum version of a scikit-learn dependency package using the argparse CLI
query_package_version: query the minimum version and tags for a specific package from dependent_packages
lookup_packages_by_tag: lookup all packages associated with a tag like docs or tests from tag_to_packages
list_all_dependency_versions: list all minimum dependency versions defined in the scikit-learn dependency file
summarize_dependencies: summarize the scikit-learn minimum dependency versions and their usage tags
